spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates that the property applies to every decoration line (underline, line-through, overline, combined), which is the spec's framing, across three realistic use cases with real <s>/<ins> semantics.

interactive.rationale: Four aria-pressed line toggles plus two em sliders re-style all three live examples and their generated code lines; verified the overline toggle switched state and re-rendered.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises strike/overline cases beyond underlines and the page delivers three of them with rationale.

edge_cases.rationale: Negative insets are in the slider range, the combined underline-overline case is offered, and the unsupported browser gets an explicit banner plus per-render fallback copy.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite covers the parse contracts this page uses; on Chromium 141 the route honestly reported 0 pass / 8 fail since the property needs Chrome 154.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): clicked the overline toggle (aria-pressed moved correctly), detail updated to the honest 'what would be applied' fallback, applied=0/3 logged as expected on this pre-154 build; console clean, desktop and mobile screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and emits a lines-rendered assert with line/inset/applied/supported per render.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout, toggle buttons override background and color together in both states, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: Line toggles are real buttons with aria-pressed, sliders have labels with live value spans, the readout is aria-live, and the examples use semantic <s>/<ins> elements.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 (scrollWidth 360, screenshot read); toggle row wraps and cases stack.

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/css-text-decoration-inset/line-through-and-overline/ with Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp), which lacks text-decoration-inset. The amber banner and per-render fallback copy handle that honestly while the toggles, sliders and generated per-case declarations keep working (verified the overline toggle and aria-pressed bookkeeping). The struck-price, overline-heading and edit-strike cases are well-chosen distinct angles with semantic markup. Console/network clean bar the sandbox font-CDN artifact; desktop 1280 and mobile 360 DPR3 screenshots read, no overflow; /conformance/ honestly reported 0 pass / 8 fail on this build. Clears the bar.
